'''Macro welders''', also called '''pocket welders''',<ref name="RP" /> were portable welding tools used to repair fine technical devices.<ref name="CSWE" /> One was once described as looking "like a tiny lightsaber."<ref name="RP" />

==Behind the scenes==
A pocket welder is mentioned in the novel ''[[Rogue Planet]]'' and there is an entry of macro welder in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', but it is unknown whether they both are describing the same thing.
